notes: === 2026-10-14 — DOSSIER BUILT (Claude Fable session) === 'Vietnam, End to End.' — 67pp book + 5pp Field Sheet + 99pp phone edition + 3pp free sample, from dossier/build (build3.py → compile-guide → render-paged). Organising fact: three climates on one 1,650 km line; the ticket and the e-visa form lock the direction before the weather table is read. 11 decisions, 14 computed figures, 18 plates from the site's own library. audit-release.py: RELEASE PASS. Evidence register: 13 sources, 34 claims; the State Department page re-read in the browser 2026-10-14 (curl gets a bot shell). ★ still the owner's: the name (default proposed), the price, the checkout link, the cover upload, the branch merge, the span backfill. See dossier/MINE.md and dossier/DELIVERABLES.md. === 2026-10-13, LATER — GOOGLE SEARCH CONSOLE === The site was LIVE WITH 100 ARTICLES AND NOT IN SEARCH CONSOLE AT ALL. All seven other sites were there as Domain properties; vietnamforamericans.com was absent, so nothing had ever been submitted and no indexing data existed. Now registered, matching the fleet convention: · Property type: DOMAIN (sc-domain:vietnamforamericans.com), not URL-prefix. Covers apex + www + http/https in one property. Requires DNS validation. · Verified via a TXT record on @ at Namecheap (Advanced DNS → Host Records): google-site-verification=JNCmFYDWUkO-6VQIzBj_4YHZxRc5mDx_V3v3PVpcg40 The existing A (@ -> 216.150.1.1) and CNAME (www -> vercel-dns) records and the locked SPF TXT under Mail Settings were NOT touched. DO NOT DELETE THIS TXT RECORD — removing it revokes the verification. · Verified first attempt ("La propriété a été validée", method: domain-name provider). · Sitemap submitted: https://www.vietnamforamericans.com/sitemap.xml (143 URLs). SITEMAP STATUS READS "Impossible de recuperer le sitemap" / "Couldn't fetch", 0 pages discovered, AND THAT IS EXPECTED, NOT A FAULT. The property was two minutes old; Google records the submission and crawls asynchronously. Everything on our side was verified at submission time rather than assumed: HTTP 200 to a Googlebot user-agent with no redirect, content-type application/xml, valid urlset parsing to 143 entries all on the www host, robots.txt both allowing it and declaring Sitemap:, and the apex 308-redirecting to www. Re-check the status in a day; if it still says couldn't-fetch THEN it is real. Two gotchas for the next site: the TXT value shown in the GSC dialog is VISUALLY TRUNCATED in a screenshot (it ended "..._V3" on screen, the real value continues "v3PVpcg40") — read it from the DOM, not a picture. And GSC's green "Sitemap envoye" toast appears even when the row behind it already says it could not be fetched; read the row, not the toast. STILL NOT DONE after this: the paid guide (name/cover/checkout — user's call), and the AFFILIATE PASS, which has never been run on this site — 0 of 100 articles carry a single affiliate link, no /go/ redirect, no disclosure. User parked it 2026-10-13 ("affiliate links can hold, for a moment"). === 2026-10-13 — READ THIS FIRST; IT CORRECTS THE SECTION BELOW === DESIGN DIRECTION, CORRECTED. The record below says the shipped design is "THE TIMETABLE" (Zilla Slab + Source Serif 4 + IBM Plex Mono, newsprint #F4F0E6 / signal red #B23A2B / board amber #C8963E). THAT DIRECTION WAS NEVER INSTALLED. The user judged it "20% of what I expect" and the work restarted. FIVE directions were then built on the real site and compared as representations before building: Split-Flap, Son Mai, Do Hoa, Bang Hieu, Bon Ban. WHAT IS LIVE IS "BON BAN" (four plates). palette primary #E8331C · primaryDeep/accentDeep #B9230F · accent #0E8C70 · highlight #FFBE0B · surface #F2EDE1 · surfaceAlt #FAF6EC · ink #0C0B0A · inkSoft #514B42 · line #D7CFBD fonts Anton (display) + Source Sans 3 (body) + Space Mono (utility, .jp) vocab role-based CSS so a swap is one file: .plate/.plate--sm, .lift, .tab, .display-echo, .row-rule, .panel-rule, .step-num, .feat-cap, .tile-band--a..d, .trust/.trust--a..d, .mark* The five candidate directions live in commit c059936 (design// with HeroArt.tsx + signature.css + manifest.json); the scaffolding was deleted on ship in 021cb22. Recover from git, do not rebuild. HERO. "the homepage hero has NO PHOTO" below is SUPERSEDED. The hero carries a four-piece clickable collage in the cream field — irregular clip-path cut-outs of Ha Noi, Ha Long, Hoi An, Ha Giang, each linking to its guide. Config: SITE.ui.heroCollage. Geometry was settled against a Playwright clearance checker that asserts no piece overlaps the headline/lead/CTA/destination nav, nothing is clipped by the hero's overflow, and no piece overlaps another, at up to 18 viewport widths (1988 -> 360). Re-run it before touching the geometry. AN EXTERNAL REVIEW (GPT, on the live site) DROVE MOST OF 2026-10-13. Its six priorities, and where each stands: 1. LOS ANGELES NONSTOP — FIXED. Four articles and the fact band claimed Vietnam Airlines flies nonstop from BOTH San Francisco and Los Angeles. It does not. Verified against the airline's own page: "there are no direct flights" from LAX, connect via SFO. SFO-SGN IS THE ONLY US-VIETNAM NONSTOP. Six occurrences corrected through a DOM, including the dependent sentence "Those two routes are the entire nonstop map". scripts/fix-lax-nonstop.mjs. 2. FONTS NOT LOADING — FIXED. The compiled CSS had :root{} at char 0 and the Google Fonts @import at char 535. An @import after a style rule is INVALID per spec, so production rendered Impact/system-ui. Fonts now load from a in layout.tsx. globals.css carries a warning comment; do not put the @import back. 3. UNSPLASH+ WATERMARKS — FIXED, see below. 4. NO OUTBOUND SOURCES — FIXED. 98 of 100 articles had no external link at all, visa pages included. Nine official source links now across eight articles (evisa.gov.vn, customs.gov.vn, dsvn.vn, vietnamairlines.com, vn.usembassy.gov), each URL opened and its title recorded before use. scripts/add-source-links.mjs. NO rel="nofollow" on a citation — that rel is for the affiliate/guide CTAs; on a .gov source it says you do not vouch for your own source. vietnam-visa-extension-guide is DELIBERATELY unlinked: extensions are in person, the e-visa portal does not handle them, and xuatnhapcanh.gov.vn serves an empty document and could not be verified. 5. GUIDE OFFER — still parked by the user ("on oublie le guide pour le moment"). 6. PLANNER — FIXED. It dropped the Hoi An -> HCMC transfer entirely (no direct leg, so the row rendered BLANK). geo.ts gained connection() composing routes by Dijkstra over real legs, a climate layer (north/centre/south month tables taken verbatim from best-time-to-visit-vietnam), gateways (HAN/SGN/DAD) and seasonFor/seasonConflict. The picker now asks where you land and which month; arrival sets the DIRECTION of the route. scripts/check-geo.mjs fails the build if any base pair is unreachable. A DESIGN CLASS BROKE THE PROSE, and this is the trap worth remembering. The user reported "the text is broken, it doesn't follow lines" in some articles. Cause: span.fact[data-fact] is the FLEET-WIDE contract for an inline fact value in running text, and the new TrustStrip took .fact for a layout block with display:block and 28px padding. It cut sentences into three across 31 of 100 articles / 79 spans. Renamed to .trust*, plus a specificity-(0,1,1) guard (span.fact[data-fact]{display:inline;padding:0;...}). BEFORE NAMING A DESIGN CLASS, GREP THE ARTICLE CORPUS FOR IT. UNSPLASH+ WATERMARKS. 11 of 196 images on this site, across 9 articles (5 heroes + 6 in-body). All replaced. Full record in WATERMARK-AUDIT-2026-10-13.md; fleet record in WATERMARK-AUDIT-FLEET-2026-10-13.md. Three things that cost time: · FIVE automated detectors failed (three periodicity, one template-average, one file-metadata). Do not rebuild one. What works is LOOKING at 1:1, with a crop that is a FRACTION of the width (22-30%), not a fixed pixel size. · A hero-only pass missed 6 of the 11. Audit in-body images too. · Replacing the R2 object was NOT enough — Cloudflare caches each transformed derivative immutable for a year. Re-keyed to -v2 and repointed featured_image, in-body and categories.featured_image. scripts/rekey-corrected-images.mjs. Check the EXACT URL the page requests. Japan (192) and Thailand (275) article images audited CLEAN. Dossier plates carrying the hand-download fingerprint — Japan A01-A08, Morocco's 7 — also checked CLEAN. NOT CHECKED: article images on Barcelona, Greece, Morocco, Rome, Turkey (~2,300), and ~199 other dossier plates. HOMEPAGE, 2026-10-13. Three defects found by reading the page: · The same three articles appeared TWICE. Nothing was flagged is_featured, so getFeaturedArticles() fell through to "the newest three with an image" — exactly the first row of the Latest grid. Now deduped structurally (the grid over-fetches and filters out whatever is featured) AND editorially: scripts/set-featured.mjs flags three head-to-head decisions that Start Here does not already cover. Band relabelled via SITE.ui.featuredArticles. · The halftone (.poster-screen) used one dot pitch for every plate, but the dot is sized in screen pixels and the plates are not. Card-sized plates now take .poster-screen--fine. · The page asked for nothing at the end, and NOTHING in the body linked the planner — /build-my-trip was reachable only from the masthead. components/ ClosingAsk.tsx, geo-guarded. · ArticleCard no longer prints a date: all 100 articles published the same day, so nine identical dates in one grid told the reader the library landed in an afternoon. TRAP: the first rebuild after a database write still served the OLD data. Next's fetch cache lives in .next/cache and SURVIVES BETWEEN BUILDS. Clear it when verifying a data change locally. HEADER OVERFLOWED AT EVERY VIEWPORT (document 1802px wide at a 1440 viewport; "Build my trip" sat on top of "My trip"). max-width does not stop flex content overflowing. Fixed with min-w-0 on the nav, desktop nav at xl not md, the search field demoted to an icon until 2xl. Likely fleet-wide — check the other six. (2) The paid guide: name, cover, pages all empty, so /guide, /guide/method and /guide/sheet 404 fail-closed and Stage 5c cannot mount. User's call. (3) The five unchecked sites' article images, above. (4) Featured Guides vs Latest Guides still both exist as bands; "Latest" is a weak axis on a corpus published in one day — worth questioning, not yet changed. === everything below is the record as of 2026-10-12 and is superseded where it === conflicts with the above (notably the design direction and the hero photo) ALL 100 ARTICLES PUBLISHED 2026-10-12. Batch 20 was the last: Vietnam+Cambodia, Cai Rang, beaches, markets, photography. Both seeds PASS 85 first round and the gate confirmed neither duplicates the eight handoffs already live. THE VISA AUDIT EARNED ITS PLACE ONE LAST TIME. Asking for a sentence-by-sentence scope check against PARAPHRASE/GLOSS/DIRECTION caught a confirmed GLOSS: the article gave both return options (multiple-entry OR a second approved visa) and then four paragraphs later said 'the version that needs THE multiple-entry visa', deleting the alternative. Also a direction ambiguity in the Tan Son Nhat example, and the no-extension span sitting next to port advice so it read as a port-amendment rule. ARITHMETIC AGAIN: 14 - 2 - 3 = 9, written as 'the week that remains'. Third batch where a stated subtraction was wrong. ASK THE GATE TO DO EVERY SUM. EXCERPT AGAIN: 'The famous ones are for visitors and the good ones are not' contradicted the body's 'Both are worth seeing'. check-batch.py's excerpt guard catches prices and counts but NOT a thesis the body disowns — the gate's excerpt-to-body table is what catches that. Keep asking. WHAT REMAINS, none of it article writing: (1) Stage 5b standard feature set — reading time, TOC, breadcrumbs, JSON-LD suite, RSS, 404, skip-link, trust/best-time/cost strips, itinerary picker. references/5-features.md. Objectively specified, no taste judgement, can be done without the user. (2) SITEMAP — the user deferred it to the end on purpose. Now is the end. (3) Reword the 'indicative snapshot from October 2026' price framing in batches 2 and 4; batch 6 was failed for implying a survey that was never run and those two still carry the stronger phrasing. (4) Stage 5 visual identity and (5) the paid guide's name — both explicitly the user's calls. (6) Stage 5c conversion surfaces need a checkout link, which needs the guide, which needs the name. GATE PROMPT TO REUSE: content/batch-20/second-gate.txt is the most developed version — ceiling split, excerpt-to-body table, published-constraints list, explicit arithmetic instruction, three-check seed test, PARAPHRASE/GLOSS/DIRECTION fact audit. --- STAGE 5b, 2026-10-12: the live site was serving TEMPLATE PLACEHOLDERS on every page (' · · ' ribbon, '//', '' in the , '<Money>/<short caption>' in the Before-you-go strip) because packages/config/site.ts was still the unfilled skeleton. AND apps/site/lib/geo.ts was entirely empty, so /build-my-trip, the itinerary picker and the destinations map were running on no data at all. Both now filled and committed on branch 'fill-site-config-and-geo' — NOT pushed, because a push to main deploys to production and that was not authorised. One merge publishes it. costTiers LEFT EMPTY ON PURPOSE: daily-budget tiers are the frozen prices hard rule 1 and corrections.json forbid, and no verified range exists in the fact layer. CostCheatsheet and TripBudget fail closed and render nothing, which is correct until the figures are sourced. PALETTE AND FONTS UNTOUCHED — still '#000000' and '<DisplayFont>'. That is the Stage 5 design direction and the user's call; it is the one thing standing between this site and a finished look. The rest of the 5b feature set (reading time, TOC, breadcrumbs, JSON-LD, RSS, 404, skip-link, progress bar, back-to-top) all ship in the template and are present. --- 2026-10-12 LATER: reviewed_at migration RUN on the shared project (SQL editor, 'Success. No rows returned'); column verified present on vietnam.articles, all values null, so the byline correctly reads 'Published'. Article hero RESTRUCTURED to the fleet pattern: title on paper + breadcrumbs, photograph below as a 3:2 figure at the full 1100px grid, scrim and 44vh container gone, one code path instead of branching on whether a photo exists. Added the DECK (the stored excerpt under the title) + .article-deck in globals.css — the template never rendered the excerpt anywhere. Logo skeleton given whitespace-nowrap + 21px: the wordmark was wrapping to three lines and spilling out of the header on every page (found by LOOKING at the live page, invisible in the markup). The last 'indicative snapshot' price framing is gone — flights-to-vietnam-from-us and domestic-flights-vietnam rewritten to planning brackets with no claimed observation, republished with preserve_status. STAGE NOW = DESIGN. Everything before it is done: 100 articles live, config filled, geo filled, fleet structure matched, sitemap 143 entries, robots + noindex correct. WHAT DESIGN NEEDS FROM THE USER: a THESIS about Vietnam for a nervous American first-timer (one sentence, rejecting the postcard read), from which palette/type/motion derive. Then packages/config/site.ts brand.palette (all '#000000' today) and brand.fonts ('<DisplayFont>', '<BodyFont>'), and apps/site/components/Logo.tsx which is still the skeleton by design. STILL BLOCKED ON THE GUIDE: costTiers deliberately empty (no verified figures — CostCheatsheet and TripBudget fail closed), guide.name/thesis/cover/pages empty so /guide, /guide/method and /guide/sheet all 404 fail-closed, and Stage 5c conversion surfaces cannot mount without a checkout link. The dossier build names the guide; the name is then backfilled into every guide-span through the admin's Name backfill. --- STAGE 5 DESIGN DONE 2026-10-12, LIVE. Direction = 'THE TIMETABLE'. THESIS: Vietnam looks like chaos and runs on a schedule you do not have yet; the site hands you the schedule. Chosen over two others that were BUILT ON THE REAL SITE and compared (screenshots): 'Lacquer' (near-black + gilt) rejected because its thesis is about craft not the reader's problem, and black-and-gold Vietnam for an American audience edges orientalist; 'A Thousand Miles' (limestone green latitude gradient) rejected as a thesis about geography, which a map already says, and closest to generic SE-Asia green. PALETTE newsprint #F4F0E6 / signal red #B23A2B / board amber #C8963E / ink #16130E. TYPE Zilla Slab + Source Serif 4 + IBM Plex Mono. THE MONO IS THE THESIS MADE MECHANICAL: any number that is a quantity of TIME is set in it. That rule is written into tokens.css as usage law. MOTION: one only — a 13s light sweep down the hero's amber rule grid, the moment a departure board refreshes. Pure CSS, off under prefers-reduced-motion. METHOD THAT WORKED: a throwaway scripts/_design-variant.mjs wrote all FOUR places a design lives (tokens.css, tailwind palette, globals font-family + @import, site.ts brand) so directions could be swapped and screenshotted on the real site. Deleted once chosen. TWO TRAPS IT EXPOSED: (1) swapping tokens alone is NOT a design — two directions with different palettes but the same primary HUE rendered an identical hero, because .motif-bg is just a gradient of --green; each direction needs its own signature CSS. (2) globals.css carries font-family declarations SEPARATE from the @import, so the first trial loaded the faces and rendered body copy in system-ui. ALSO FIXED: BestTimeStrip had best=muted brass and good=amber, so the driest months rendered drabber than the workable ones — the chart argued against its own legend. categories.featured_image was null on all 39 (homepage Destinations band was flat colour blocks); now set, main categories picked deliberately. skeleton-check still had the pre-2026-09-24 rule banning ALL raw forms; ported the fleet's narrowed version (a POST to the site's own /api/ is allowed). STILL OPEN: the homepage hero has NO PHOTO — SITE.ui.heroImage is '' and no site_settings row, so it is the flat motif. The skill wants a DEDICATED landing image there, not an article photo. That is the single biggest remaining visual gap. Guide/dossier deliberately parked by the user ('il n'y a personne pour le moment').
